title: Pet Simulator targeting, reduced pet speed, E-key egg hatch
description: 1. Ensure E-key ProximityPrompt works for egg hatching. 2. Reduce pet movement speed for natural look. 3. Implement Pet Simulator-style targeting: single click sends 1 pet, hold sends all pets, idle auto-distributes pets to different destructibles.
steps: Verify and fix ProximityPrompt E-key egg interaction in ZoneService and Main.client.lua
Reduce pet follow/movement speed in PetController for smoother, more natural movement
Rework PetController auto-attack to distribute pets to DIFFERENT destructibles (each pet picks its own target)
Rework Main.client.lua input handling: single click sends 1 pet, hold (0.3s) sends all pets
acceptance_criteria: E-key ProximityPrompt triggers egg hatch when near egg station
Pet movement speed is noticeably slower/smoother (no teleporting feel)
Single left click on destructible sends only 1 pet to attack it
Holding left click (0.3s+) on destructible sends ALL pets to attack it
When idle (not clicking), pets auto-distribute to different destructibles (not all same target)
When a destructible is destroyed, the pet auto-finds next available target
BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx is regenerated and valid XML
